scope: Research-only normalization planning. This file describes how later import should use the candidate research; it does not create runtime route, source, public or generated app data.
doNotRunDuringThisTask: any command that rewrites shared generated app outputs

overallDecision.reason: All eight sections are researched and static caveats now have a controlling policy, but runtime import still needs an explicit import task, geometry implementation, GIS overlays for boundary-sensitive rules, duplicate facility resolution and publication-time checks for unstable facts.

canonicalTrail.type: closed ring split into eight official linear stages
canonicalTrail.distancePolicy: Use official section-page display distances where straightforward. For Etapp 5, display about 19 km and preserve Naturkartan 21.4 km as a duplicate-geometry artifact note; keep computed GPX lengths as geometry metadata.

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Use track 1 followed by reversed track 2, snapping the approximately 0.2 m join.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use official GPX endpoint for route continuity with Etapp 2. Keep Nynäs/Nynässtugan as the human stage-goal facility and access/cabin metadata; do not snap the geometry to the cabin without a sourced access leg.
endpointGaps: Normalized GPX endpoint is about 565.9 m from Nynäs cabin marker.
Etapp 2 GPX start matches the Etapp 1 normalized endpoint.
geometryPlan.geometryGradeForImport: usable after track reversal, but route/cabin endpoint policy must be explicit

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Use official GPX in stored order. No reversal or sequencing needed.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use GPX start for continuity from Etapp 1 and keep Nynäs cabin as nearby stage-goal/access metadata around route km 0.699. Use Lönhult cabin as endpoint facility metadata, not a geometry snap target.
endpointGaps: Nynäs cabin marker is about 565.9 m direct from GPX start; nearest GPX point is about 13.1 m from cabin marker at route km 0.699.
Lönhult cabin marker is about 24.2 m direct from the GPX endpoint.
geometryPlan.geometryGradeForImport: navigation-grade with Nynäs endpoint policy caveat

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Apply sequence 10, 1, 9R, 8, 6R, 7, 5, 2R, 4R, 3R. Snap or bridge documented small joins under about 35 m as metadata.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use GPX endpoints for section continuity. Keep Lönhult and Krokstorp cabin markers as endpoint facility metadata.
endpointGaps: Start is about 24.2 m from Lönhult cabin.
End is about 26.4 m from Krokstorp cabin.
Largest documented route-piece joins are 33.98 m and 23.01 m near Krokstorp.
geometryPlan.geometryGradeForImport: navigation-grade after sequencing/reversal; raw GPX is not importable

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Apply sequence 7R, 8R, 9R, 10, 1R, 5, 6R, 2, 3R. Drop or deduplicate track 4 because it is a 9.9 m internal duplicate of track 3.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use repaired GPX endpoints; keep Krokstorp and Mörtfors cabin markers as endpoint facilities. Do not use the route-page pin as an endpoint.
endpointGaps: Krokstorp cabin marker is 26.4 m from normalized route start.
Mörtfors cabin marker is 5.7 m from normalized route end.
geometryPlan.geometryGradeForImport: navigation-grade after sequencing; raw GPX is not importable

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Discard T2 as exact duplicate of T1. Reverse T1 from Mörtfors cabin area to shared junction. Reverse T3, trim the stored final 4.037 m overshoot/tail, then join at the shared junction and continue to Stjärneberg.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use repaired GPX endpoints. Keep Mörtfors and Stjärneberg cabin markers as endpoint facility metadata. Do not carry a static Stjärneberg closed/arsenic warning.
endpointGaps: Mörtfors cabin marker is 5.654 m from cleaned GPX start.
Stjärneberg cabin marker is 7.872 m from cleaned GPX end.
Naturkartan route page/API marker is a mid-route junction and must not be treated as an endpoint.

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Reverse the single official GPX track to official Stjärneberg-to-Lilla Laxemar direction. Do not replace with lower-density API linework.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use reversed GPX endpoints. Keep Stjärneberg and Lilla Laxemar cabin clusters as endpoint facility metadata.
endpointGaps: Stjärneberg cabin marker is 7.87 m from corrected GPX start.
Lilla Laxemar cabin marker is 13.83 m from corrected GPX end.
Naturkartan stage marker equals the Lilla Laxemar endpoint, not the Stjärneberg start.

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Use official GPX unchanged in stored Lilla Laxemar-to-Hällveberg direction.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use GPX endpoints. Use Hällveberg as display name; preserve Hedvigsberg as older alias. Do not include Figeholm/Fårbo/Fårbosjön detours in main geometry without sourced spur geometry.
endpointGaps: Lilla Laxemar cabin marker is 13.8 m from GPX start.
Hällveberg cabin marker is 15.9 m from GPX end.

geometryPlan.normalizationAction: Use official GPX after sequencing tracks 8, 4, 3, 1, 5R, 6R and excluding duplicate sliver tracks 2 and 7.
geometryPlan.endpointDecision: Use official GPX endpoint to close the digital ring with Etapp 1. Keep Lilla Hycklinge cabin marker as endpoint facility/access metadata pending a separately sourced access leg.
endpointGaps: Hällveberg cabin marker is 14.7 m from normalized GPX start.
Lilla Hycklinge cabin marker is 156.4 m from normalized GPX end.
Naturkartan Etapp 8 marker is mid-route, not start/end.
geometryPlan.geometryGradeForImport: navigation-grade after sequencing and duplicate-sliver removal

importAsCandidateFacilities: Official endpoint cabin clusters: Nynäs, Lönhult, Krokstorp, Mörtfors, Stjärneberg, Lilla Laxemar, Hällveberg, Lilla Hycklinge.
High-confidence official access/parking/toilet records already present in section files, subject to duplicate resolution.
High-confidence official POIs such as Snäckedal and Stensjö by, preserving access restrictions.
modelAsFacilityMetadataOrClusteredSubfac: Cabin-yard wells, taps, toilets, fireplaces, grills and woodsheds where no separate source-backed coordinate exists.
Stjärneberg well, Hällveberg well, Lilla Laxemar summer/winter water, Lilla Hycklinge water/toilet and similar cabin-support details.
modelAsAccessOrServiceMetadata: Figeholm, Fårbo, Klintemåla, Stensjö by service, Tilias and other food/lodging/shop/marina clusters unless they are route-adjacent and source-backed.
Hällveberg access via Sippetorp/Fårbo E22 because the cabin has no direct car road access.
keepPendingOrSuppressFromDefaultImport: Protected-area or water-protection context not confirmed by GIS overlay.
dedupeKeysToReview: Shared endpoint cabins between adjacent stages.
Mörtfors toilets/parking records shared between Etapp 4 and Etapp 5.
Krokstorp cabin/toilet/well records shared between Etapp 3 and Etapp 4.
Lilla Laxemar records shared between Etapp 6 and Etapp 7.
Hällveberg records shared between Etapp 7 and Etapp 8.

applyAsStaticRulesOnlyWhenConfirmed: Official reserve/cultural-reserve rules where the source says the route passes through the area, such as Humlenäs and Stensjö by.
Cabin-specific no-outdoor-fire/no-electricity/boil-water wording from current official cabin pages, with accessed dates.
requiresGisOverlayBeforeRuleImport: other water-protection areas near route context

normalizationImplementationNotes: Implement geometry transforms in a staging script or notebook under candidate research first; do not write public/data, public/routes or data/source/hiking until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.
For each normalized section, preserve raw source URL, transform instructions, computed length, official display distance, endpoint gap notes and route-page marker caveats.
Generate visual QA artifacts only under candidate research if needed.
Before runtime import, run a map visual review of every repaired multi-track section against the official PDF/map viewer and adjacent section endpoints.
Do not silently drop route-piece joins; store join distances in metadata where they exceed normal GPS jitter.
recommendedNextStep: If runtime integration is later requested, first implement a candidate-only geometry normalization prototype and QA output under data/research/candidate-trails/ostkustleden/, then review it before touching shared hiking source data.
